# synthetic: an environment variable read, checked as an int, and bound or given through int()
import os


def tune(con):
    mb = int(os.environ.get("SYNTH_WORK_MB", "64"))
    con.execute(f"SET work_mem = '{mb}MB'")
    con.execute("SELECT set_config('work_mem', ?, false)", (os.environ.get("SYNTH_WORK_MEM", "64MB"),))
